review_description: Excellent customer service and follow up from John ( captain Green Solar)Good value for moneySmooth installation , no roof damage

Angus quoted promptly and was happy to answer any questions that came up.He was also able to do the installation quicker than other companies.As he is in the local area we were happy to go ahead with him, even without any referrals being available due to his own business being relatively new.Although other quotes from out of our area were cheaper, we preferred the option of being able to contact a local (and the actual installer) in the event of any issues later.He offered options when our preferred inverter was proving hard to obtain, but in the end was able to source our model from interstate.Neat, tidy and on time installation, good clean up after, with no issues so far.

Angus Flanagan Solar was fantastic to deal with. His price was the best we had and would recommend him to anyone who was looking to put solar on their roof. Angus was very knowledgeable about his product, he was efficient, and turned up when he said he would.
